about: The four dossier screenshots of Vice Ledger (gta6-trophy-guide-01), rendered from the app in this repository by take-shots.mjs: the app served locally, driven in the Chrome Headless Shell at a 1280x800 viewport, with a part-finished tracker state seeded in localStorage (key vice-ledger-gta6-v1) so each page shows the tracker mid-use rather than empty.
format: JPEG, each file at most 262144 bytes
seed: 14 of 55 trophies earned; counters part-way on the tracked trophies (for example 3 of 5 bank vaults on Maximum Withdrawal, 132 of 250 stunts on Cunning Stunts); one player note written on Maximum Withdrawal

shots.shows: The checklist with earned trophies ticked and the guide pane open on Maximum Withdrawal: official description, guide in our own words, the 3/5 progress counter and the sources box below. Spoiler shield off, hidden trophies revealed.
The eight-stage roadmap to the platinum, each stage block listing its trophies as chips with the seeded ones already earned. Spoiler shield off, hidden trophies revealed.
The missables page: the eight trophies that can be locked out, each with its warning note on when the chance closes. Spoiler shield off, hidden trophies revealed.
The same checklist narrowed to story trophies with the spoiler shield on: unearned story trophy names and descriptions are masked, so the page can be browsed without giving the plot away.
shots.view: Checklist & guide, Story filter, spoiler shield on
